{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Al'Ori'Ramikade''''' was a title in the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] culture, meaning "'''Commander of Supercommandos'''" when translated from the [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] [[Language/Legends|language]] into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref> The title was often a secondary one, attributed to the [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']],<ref name="ImpCom501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref> the traditional leader of all the Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] clans.<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> The ''Al'Ori'Ramikade'' title referenced the Mandalorian ruler's ability to [[Commander/Legends|command]] their people's [[Mandalorian Supercommando|supercommando]] forces<ref name="Revelation" /> in accordance with the tenets of the ''[[Resol'nare]]'', the six central principles of Mandalorian culture.<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>

[[Jaster Mereel]], a Mandalorian soldier from [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]] who served as ''Mand'alor'' prior to and during the [[Mandalorian Civil War (True Mandalorians)|Mandalorian Civil War]],<ref name="HotM">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref> was known to use the title of ''Al'Ori'Ramikade'', and did so during an encounter he had with [[Regent of Mek va Uil|the regent]] of [[Mek va Uil]].<ref name="O66" /> [[Standard decade/Legends|Decades]] later, after [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] succeeded [[Fenn Shysa]] as ''Mand'alor'',<ref name="HotM" /> Fett also made use of the Commander of Supercommandos title.<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The title of Commander of Supercommandos first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' novel [[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines|''Bloodlines'']], written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[August 29]], [[2006]]. Traviss created the title, attributing it as a secondary title to the reigning Mandalore.<ref name="Bloodlines" /> The title appeared again in her subsequent entries into the multi-[[Author/Legends|author]] series, [[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice|''Sacrifice'']]<ref name="Sacrifice" /> and [[Legacy of the Force: Revelation|''Revelation'']], the latter of which debuted the ''Mando'a'' incarnation of the title, ''Al'Ori'Ramikade''.<ref name="Revelation" /> Traviss also featured the title in two of her [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' novels]], [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']]<ref name="O66" /> and ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />
